canon_efficiency.note: Canon directed efficiency 0.8 exceeds the charged share: with 0.21 neutral and 0.10 synchrotron the ceiling is 0.69 before nozzle losses, 0.62 after.

optimistic.label: hot-ion mode (Te = Ti/2), D-rich 0.5:1; Te/Ti = 0.5 is unproven for D-3He (alpha and proton slowing heat electrons)

central.label: Ti = Te = 100 keV, 1:1 (the v2 baseline); matches the NASA DFD bremsstrahlung share (0.205)

canon_ratio.label: Ti = Te = 100 keV at the WORKING canon 2.5:1 He3:D: more He-3 means fewer reactions per electron

absorbers.verdict: A column that absorbs 100 keV bremsstrahlung (25-500 kg/m2) cannot also reach exhaust-class specific energy while it stays in place: the pressure is 10^5-10^7 times the 150 T Fiji magnetic pressure. Ablation needs 10^4-10^6 kg/s per TW. The whole hydrogen flow as a coolant carries ~0.05 GW. X-ray energy cannot be routed into the exhaust at Wayfarer ve.

xray_optics.verdict: Below the critical angle a mirror deflects rays by at most 2 theta_c (0.1-1 deg); it cannot turn isotropic emission away from coils or the shield. Multilayers extend to ~80 keV only in narrow bands at a few theta_c. REJECTED.
